en: Black-and-white panoramic view of a coastal town built on rocky terrain. There are many wooden houses with steep roofs and porches, a prominent church with a tall spire near the center, and water with small islands in the background. In the lower left corner the place name "SMÖGEN" is printed, and in the lower right corner there is a triangular logo with the number 1063, suggesting a commercial postcard series.
